```as
/// An artboard of a file decoded with `Context.decodeFile`. Assign it to a
/// view model artboard property (see `ViewModel.getArtboard`) and whatever
/// is bound to that property shows it.
export class BindableArtboard {
    /// The artboard's name.
    get name(): string;

    /// The instance of the artboard's own view model that it is bound to, or
    /// null when the artboard has none. Changes to it show in the artboard.
    get data(): ViewModel?;

    /// True when both refer to the same artboard of the same decoded file.
    equals(other: BindableArtboard?): bool;

    /// Releases the artboard now instead of when it is collected. A property
    /// it was assigned to keeps showing it.
    release(): void;
}

/// A Rive file decoded with `Context.decodeFile`. Only assets embedded in the
/// file load, and its scripts run only if Rive signed them.
export class RiveFile {
    /// The names of the file's artboards, in file order.
    get artboardNames(): Array<string>;

    /// The named artboard, or the file's default artboard when name is null;
    /// null when there is no such artboard.
    bindableArtboard(name: string? = null): BindableArtboard?;

    /// Releases the file now instead of when it is collected. Artboards taken
    /// from it keep working.
    release(): void;
}
```
